app.title: Back office
app.error: Something went wrong. Reload the page; if it stays, tell the support team.

login.title: Sign in
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check the shop code, username and password.
login.limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.

password.title: Choose a new password
password.help: Before you continue, replace the password you were given with your own.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.

passwordProblem.contains_username: Do not put your username in your password.

home.nothing: There is nothing here for your role yet.

staff.title: Staff
staff.help: Everyone who works in the shop. Give each person a role, a temporary PIN for the counter, and a back-office password only if they need one.
staff.name: Name
staff.saved: {{name}} has a temporary PIN. Tell them in person; they choose their own at the counter.
staff.weak_pin: Choose a harder PIN: 4 to 6 digits, not a run like 1234 and not one digit repeated.
staff.shortCodeField: Short code (optional, for unlocking a counter)
staff.rolesHelp: Each role gives a set of permissions. Templates follow the shop's job list.
staff.rolesSaved: Roles saved. Counters pick them up at their next sync.

password.title: Back-office password
password.none: {{name}} has no back-office password and can only unlock counters.
password.has: {{name}} can sign in to the back office.
password.temporaryHelp: Tell the person in person. They must replace it with their own at their first sign-in.
password.saved: {{name}} has a temporary password. Their open sessions were ended.
password.removeConfirm: {{name}} will be signed out and can no longer use the back office. Counters still work with their PIN.
password.optionalHelp: Leave empty for someone who only works at the counter. Otherwise a temporary one, at least 10 characters: they replace it at their first sign-in.

staff.deactivateConfirm: {{name}} is signed out everywhere and disappears from the counters at their next sync. Their bills and history stay.

errors.duplicate_username: Another person already has this username.
errors.duplicate_shortCode: Another person already has this short code.
errors.duplicate_email: Another person already has this email.
errors.cannot_grant: You can't give or take away a role with rights you don't have yourself.
errors.self: You can't do this to your own account.
errors.last_owner: The shop must keep at least one active Owner.
errors.weak_password: Choose a longer temporary password: at least 10 characters, without the username.
errors.pin_not_allowed: Only someone with at least this person's rights can give them a temporary PIN. Ask the owner.

staff.pinHelp: Give a temporary PIN to someone new or who forgot theirs. At their first unlock the counter makes them choose their own, and a new PIN also clears a lock on every counter at its next sync.
staff.reactivateConfirm: {{name}} can sign in again (if they have a password) and appears on the counters at their next sync.

counters.title: Counters
counters.help: To set up a counter PC, create a one-time code here and type it on that PC within the hour.
counters.name: Name (optional)
counters.revoked: {{code}} is revoked: it can no longer sync.
counters.confirmHelp: It stops syncing at once. Its unsynced bills stay on the PC: re-enable it here to let them sync. Bills it makes while revoked are flagged for review.
counters.confirmReenableHelp: It can sync again, and its waiting bills reach the server. Bills it made while revoked are flagged for review.
counters.reenabled: {{code}} is enabled again: its bills will sync.

reports.failed: The report could not be read. Try again; if it stays, tell the support team.

day.title: Day reconciliation
day.help: One business day of a branch: is it final, how each cash session closed, and every cash bill that never reached the drawer.
day.transit: Cash in transit at the end of the day: {{amount}} (0 when every cash bill reached the drawer)
day.noSessions: No cash session on this day.
day.deskSaid: the desk counted against {{amount}}: some documents haven’t arrived
day.noMissing: Every cash bill reached the drawer.

hold.day_not_over: The day isn’t over yet: it ends at {{time}}.
hold.device_not_heard: {{device}} hasn’t been heard from since the day ended (last: {{time}}).
hold.device_unsynced: {{device}} still has documents of the day to send (oldest {{time}}).

ack.own_variance: You can’t acknowledge the variance of your own session.
ack.nothing_to_acknowledge: There is no variance to acknowledge.
ack.forbidden: Your role can’t acknowledge a variance.

variance.title: Cash variance
variance.help: Every counted cash session in the dates, and each cashier’s total.
variance.none: No counted session in these dates.
